---
name: Headset compatibility / 耳機相容性
about: Report first-wear and re-wear dictation results.
---

- App version / App 版本:
- Phone and Android version / 手機與 Android 版本:
- Headset and dictation app / 耳機與聽寫 App:
- First wear: did the expected phrase appear? / 第一次佩戴是否正確出字？
- After removing and putting the headset back on: did a different phrase appear correctly? / 摘下再戴後是否正確出字？
- Optional: describe route changes or errors near the test time. Omit private text, device addresses, recordings, and screenshots of personal conversations.
